style: Same cartoon art style as the reference image: thick black outlines, flat colors, white round heads with big expressive eyes, comic look. SKIP: exactly the man from the reference with spiky blue hair, white round head, orange hoodie over grey collared shirt, navy cargo pants. NIA: his wife, same white round-head cartoon style, big dark curly afro puff hair, small gold hoop earrings, lavender long-sleeve top, grey joggers. Vertical 9:16, no text, no captions.

shots.kitchen_6pm: Home kitchen at 6 PM, warm evening light through window. Skip at left holding car keys, leaning toward Nia, asking. Nia at right leaning on the counter scrolling her phone, waving him off, relaxed.
shots.car_drivethru: Inside a car at a fast-food drive-thru at dusk, view from the passenger side. Skip in the driver seat at the speaker box, side-eyeing straight at the camera with a smug trusting face. Menu board glowing outside.
shots.couch_640: Living room couch in the evening. Skip sitting at left holding a burger with an open paper fast-food bag and a large fries on the coffee table. Nia sitting very close at right, reaching for fries with four fries in her hand, sweet innocent face. Skip staring at her hand.
shots.couch_645: Same living room couch. Fries box half empty, ketchup bottle in Nia's hand, Nia chewing with cheeks full and happy. Skip at left holding the empty-ish fries box, annoyed, eyebrows raised.
shots.bedroom_10pm: Dark bedroom at night, blue moonlight, lamp off. Skip sitting straight up in bed, eyes wide, looking at the camera in disbelief. Nia lying beside him under the blanket, peeking with puppy eyes, hand on her stomach.
shots.kitchen_1005: Home kitchen at night, light from the open microwave. Skip pulling a second fast-food paper bag out of the microwave, proud grin. Nia in pajamas hugging him from the side, delighted, hearts in her eyes.
